headline: The guardrail bends on purpose
hook_visual: A moving sedan compresses a barrier at the point of contact

evidence.claim: The beam and posts can deform to manage a vehicle impact

shots.visual_proof: Vehicle makes visible contact with the rail
shots.mechanism_change: Rail bends away from vehicle while it continues moving
shots.narration_en: A guardrail is designed to bend during a crash.

shots.visual_proof: Connected posts and beam share the loading
shots.mechanism_change: The beam bows and more than one post deflects visibly
shots.narration_en: The steel beam and posts spread out the crash force.
